buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Eligibility / Qualifying Requirement (a) The firm should have valid registration number as GST practitioner. (Produc e copy of self-attested registration certificate).

(b) Minimum Similar Work Experience Criteria:- i. Three (03) similar completed works, each costing not less than Rs. 2,54 ,222/-. OR ii. Two (02) similar completed works, each costing not less than Rs. 3,17,7 77/-. OR iii. One (01) similar completed work costing not less than Rs. 5,08,443/-. The similar works are hereby defined as following:- Ø Preparing, Checking, Scrutinizing and filing of Quarterly GST ref und application (GST RFD-10A) of average value more than Rs. 5 Cr and filing of Monthly GSTR-3B for taxable/Non-taxable outwar d supplies of average monthly value of more than Rs. 30 Cr. Ø Experience certificates submitted in support of the above criteria must b e duly certified by the concerned organization where the assignment wa s rendered. All supporting documents must be uploaded along with the bid, failing which the bid is liable to be rejected. (c) Bidder must have Goods and Service Tax Identification Number (GSTIN) If t urnover more than 20 Lakhs. (Produce self-attested copy of GSTIN certificate) (d) The firm should preferably be empanelled with the Office of Comptroller an d Auditor General of India (C&AG). (Produce copy of self-attested C&AG empan elled certificate). (e) The bidder or, in the case of a partnership firm, the firm shall be liable to o pen a Registered/functional office at Hisar within a period of 30 (thirty) days fr om the date of award of contract, in the event of selection as L-1. Hence, a con firmation letter w.r.t the same must be submitted with the bid. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Service Required: Filing of tax returns, processing and obtaining refunds to the aut hority concerned at CSD Depot Hisar. Detailed description of services required is mentioned below. Further, the total sales reported by CSD Depot, Hisar in Fi nancial year 2025-26 is more than 1750 crores. Hence the quantum of work m entioned below is proportional to the total sales. 8.1. Scope of services to be provided by the successful bidder: (a) Preparing, checking, scrutinizing and filing of monthly GSTR (1/2/3/3B) ret urns including revised return (s) if required. (b) To check veracity and correctness of data before filing of GST returns. (c) To track 2A/2B entries and reconcile 2A/2B form on monthly basis and on c umulative basis and reconcile with the books of accounts. (d) To Identify and report vendors who are not filling GST returns. (e) Preparing, checking, scrutinizing and filing of monthly VAT / CST returns fo r liquor including revised return (s) if required. (f) Preparing, checking, scrutinizing and filing of quarterly GST refund applicat

ion (GST RFD10A) within 180 days from the last day of the quarter in which the supply was received at depot. (g) Preparing, checking, scrutinizing and filing of annual returns under GST. (h) Preparing, checking, scrutinizing and filing of annual VAT return / refund. (i) To provide full assistance for processing and obtaining various refunds dur ing the period of contract. (j) Preparing, checking, scrutinizing and filing of online Electronic Tax Deducte d at Source (E-TDS) return. Advising on issued related to TDS. (k) Preparing, checking, scrutinizing and filing of online Electronic Tax Collect ed at Source (E-TCS) return. Advising on issued related to TCS. (l) The bidder shall ensure physical presence, as and when required, for matte rs pertaining to: monthly VAT/CST compliance; issuance, reconciliation, and follow-up of C-Forms; filing of VAT returns and allied compliances; submissi on of tax payment proofs and supporting documents before the concerned authorities; follow-up and expeditious processing of GST refund claims; repr esentation in assessment proceedings for GST refund claims; representatio n in assessments, scrutiny proceedings, and departmental audits; and atte ndance in connection with departmental inspections, notices, and other pro ceedings before tax authorities. (m) The bidder shall ensure timely availability for meetings and compliance- related matters and shall attend proceedings before the concerned tax aut horities without claiming any separate travelling, lodging, or incidental expe nses. (n) Replying to normal demand/intimations received from tax authority by the depot on tax related matter. (o) Time to time keeping the authority at CSD Depot updated about various n otifications / circulars / orders issued by State / Central Govt. regarding tax related matters or any amendment made to existing GST / VAT rules which are directly or indirectly affecting CSD operations and providing assistance in implementation of such notifications / orders / circulars. (p) Providing quarterly report regarding Govt. notifications / circulars / orders issued during the quarter with remarks applicable / not applicable to CSD a gainst each notification / circular / order. (q) To render advice on tax related matters as and when sought. (r) To provide all necessary assistance and guidance for any other matters rel ated to VAT/GST. (s) To review and suggest overall improvement in regulatory compliance, if c onsidered necessary. (t) Advising on accounting issues, suggesting improvement in systems, proce dures and accounting records with respect to Taxation and compliance etc. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG

Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of CANTEEN STORES DEPARTMENT HISAR DEPOT, PUBLIC FUND ACCOUNT (MAIN) payable at HISAR . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
